verdict.rationale: ROS 2's CLI tools and GUI-adjacent tools (e.g., bag record/play, security keystore creation, topic pub) are documented as thin wrappers over the same client library APIs (Python/C++), and docs explicitly note both C++ and Python APIs work for bag recording/reading, security setup, etc. This implies strong API/CLI parity by design, but there's no explicit first-party statement guaranteeing that every UI-based tool (e.g., rqt graphical plugins, RViz configuration) has a fully equivalent API, and no independent confirmation of complete parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation for GUI tools like rqt/RViz, and independent verification that no UI-only capability exists.
